The failure of a single underlying primitive (e.g., an AWS region or a root DNS server) triggers a simultaneous collapse across the 'decentralized' network, whereas a single large service can implement vertically integrated, multi-region redundancy to mitigate this specific layer of risk.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
